evidence: Enumerated every refusal/hidden/absent/unchanged leg across all dimensions and checked each has a matching success observed in the same row. Global: functional prompt.md:13 'Every refusal row needs its own positive control: a successful action of the same kind, observed in this review.'; every criterion ends 'Fails if any condition stated above does not hold', so the named control is a graded leg; the in-dimension backend gate (functional prompt.md:11, polish prompt.md:11, visual prompt.md:11) requires a real UI job+candidate write read back by the Observer in an independent context, zeroing blank/static/browser-only apps. Gates: hro_gate_render pairs wrong-password-stays-signed-out with correct sign-in to a populated workspace (render judge.toml:123, prompt.md:96 'A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control'). Functional (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml): hro_job_open:29 ('the successful opening is the control'); hro_add_email_rules:47 (same address on another job accepted); hro_move_one_stage:56 (one-stage forward/back work + skip refused); hro_reject_reason:83 (reason-rejection succeeds); hro_reject_hired:92 ('A rejection of a non-hired card is the control', card must first reach Hired); hro_reopen:101 (reopen to own stage required); hro_interview_full:110 ('the two cards that entered Interview are the control'; replay is of a captured successful move); hro_undo_full:128 ('other successful undos ... are the control'); hro_mgr_early_refused:155 ('their late-stage moves are the control'; open-job/add-candidate success is the gate-proven Recruiter action); hro_mgr_other_job:164 (own manager's move); hro_observer_readonly:173 (Rafael's identical successful requests; Observer session validity proven by the gate's Observer readback); hro_candidate_no_staff:182 (candidate's own data loads in that session, 'A candidate who cannot sign in or receives none of their own data makes this row 0'); hro_anonymous:191 ('A signed-in success of each is the control'); hro_stale_refused:200 (original move + refusal must name the person = positive content); hro_bulk_all_or_none:218, hro_bulk_places:227 (successful multi-card / two-card moves); hro_undo_conflict:245, hro_undo_once:254 (successful undos; Z's move must have succeeded); hro_activity_refusals:272 ('The successful actions' lines are the control' - an app with no Activity fails); hro_notes:281 (own manager and Recruiter notes succeed; Observer must read both); hro_msg_compose:308 ('A normal send is the control'); hro_thread_access:362 (Rafael, Mei and J2's manager Bill write; Observer must read - so Ingrid 'not listed' and Observer 'no send control' cannot pass on a dead conversations feature); hro_candidate_private:389 (own applications/conversations load; 'none of its own data is 0'; not-found probe paired with own conversation loading); hro_unread_counts:335 / hro_unread_scrolled_up:344 / hro_seen:353 (non-rise/no-jump/not-seen legs paired with rise-by-two, a notice within 15 s, and seen-after-Tomas-opens); hro_drafts:371 ('survives sending' paired with send clearing); hro_restart:407 (no re-seed paired with work persisting). Polish (tests/scored/polish/judge.toml): hro_pol_live_board:43 and hro_pol_live_thread:52 explicitly score 0 if the remote update never arrives ('preservation cannot be shown'); hro_pol_earlier_place:61 requires earlier messages actually loaded above; hro_pol_failed_send:70 requires a successful single resend; hro_pol_session_resume:79 names its positive control (post-sign-in send) and pairs Mei's empty boxes with Rafael's drafts still present. Visual rows are craft Likerts with no negative legs. Weak-app trials (mental): (a) dead app with all writes 4xx - gate fails, all binaries 0; (b) app whose reject endpoint always refuses - hro_reject_hired loses its control and hro_reject_reason fails; (c) app with no live transport - non-rise/no-jump/preserved-draft rows all fail on their arrival legs; (d) Observer/candidate login broken - gate (Observer) and hro_candidate_no_staff/hro_candidate_private controls fail. Conforming alternatives: hiding refused controls is explicitly allowed (hro_move_one_stage, hro_reject_hired, hro_mgr_other_job, hro_observer_readonly, hro_undo_once; prompt.md:23 replays the closest observed request); 401 for anonymous and 404 for another application are public (hireops_rules.md:21-23), so no conforming app is failed by a control requirement. Residual (not a defect for this row): no configured judge run or weak-app reward-discrimination measurement exists (raw-evidence-index.json scope: 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'); that runtime evidence is owned by the separate runtime records and is not claimed here. Some criteria list only the negative in their explicit 'Fails if' sentence (e.g. hro_reject_hired, hro_mgr_early_refused) and rely on the catch-all plus prompt.md:13 for the control; wording is adequate, a judge-run would confirm.
